en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a lakeside resort or village surrounded by dense coniferous forest. A calm, elongated lake dominates the upper center, with reflections of trees on its surface. Along the near shore stands a cluster of wooden buildings in a coherent style, likely lodges or holiday cabins, linked by winding roads and footpaths. More scattered houses and chalets sit among trees and landscaped gardens, with a small ornamental pond visible in the foreground. The setting is hilly, heavily wooded, and appears rural and tranquil. No printed caption or handwritten text is visible on the image side.
